newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Advanced Micro raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Advanced Micro raised.

text.p: -- Montgomery Securities said its analyst Jonathan Joseph raised his rating on the shares of Advanced Micro Devices to hold from sell based on the stock's valuation.
-- Advanced Micro shares were up 1-1/8 to 16 by midday.
-- Joseph expects the company to report a net loss of $0.48 a share for 1996 and a net profit of $0.10 a share for 1997.
-- In a written statement, Joseph said the outlook for losses has diminished and it is unlikely the stock will trade below its book value in the near term.

-- Alternatively, he sees Advanced Micro as "severely disadvantaged" in the microprocessor area with a sixth-generation product that is less advanced than newer memory chips being offered by Intel Corp and others.
-- Advanced Micro shares have fallen dramatically since the summer of 1995 when it traded as high as 38-5/8. It hit a low of 10-1/2 in July.
-- Yesterday the company reported a third quarter loss of $0.28 per share, narrower than the $0.36 Wall Street had expected.
